_README: EMPTY BY DESIGN. An address enters here only with the evidence that
identified it, produced on THIS VIN. A mode 22 reply is just bytes: a
wrong address returns a plausible number rather than an error, and that
number will condemn a good part.
correlation  - logged beside a standard channel whose meaning is known,
r-squared >= 0.99 over >= 200 paired samples. The same
regression measures the scale and offset.
manipulation - a physical change PREDICTED IN WRITING first, then made,
then observed. For channels with no standard twin.
verified:false entries are carried but every reading from one is flagged.
